verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs, such as campaigns or periodic call workflows, is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no recurring scheduler, cron, or scheduled workflow feature. Automatic data-retention deletion and AI QA sampling are adjacent automatic behaviors, not user-defined recurring schedules, and one-off outbound call creation does not count as a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
